$comment: Fully strict contract for the vep_zero_shot artifact — the zero-shot variant-effect registry batch output (SC-6/REV-08, produced offline by script/zero_shot_vep.py over the DNALLM suite v1.2.1 kernels; NEVER at page render). Disclosure: rows carry one entry per models_info registry model — 62 always — with DL-architecture and empty-type rows as excluded-with-reason rows, never drops. Scoring conventions are suite-owned (dnallm/inference/vep.py @ v1.2.1) and only disclosed here: deltas are alt-minus-ref so DELETERIOUS variants are NEGATIVE; AUROC/AUPRC are computed over the deleteriousness score -delta (higher = more pathogenic). Cohort rules (the D-17 ClinVar convention): SNVs only, strict Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic vs Benign/Likely_benign CLNSIG whitelist (VUS/conflicting/novel excluded, never guessed), >=1 review star. Sanity semantics: synonymous_median / nonsense_median are median paradigm deltas over the cohort's codon-translation classes — the SYNTHETIC-COHORT convention is frame-0, +strand codon translation from contig offset 0 (real-cohort consequence classes require transcript annotation and stay post-E2' work); pass is true iff nonsense_median < synonymous_median, and is null when either median is missing (never fabricated). rc_control is reported for causal (CLM) models ONLY — forward AUROC, reverse-complement AUROC, and their absolute asymmetry; null on masked (MLM) rows and on rows that never scored. An evaluation failure (model load, the suite's paradigm-architecture guard, cohort contract violation) carries paradigm plus excluded_reason='evaluation failed: ...' with null metric fields — a loud row-level failure, never a silent re-paradigm. Publication gate (resolved research OQ 1): this schema ships with committed synthetic fixtures only; the dnallm-mark/data artifact and any site link wait for real post-E2' runs.

paradigm.description: Registry type-column paradigm; null on DL/EMPTY exclusion rows.

tokenizer_type.description: Normalized registry Tokenizer value (the 6-mer spelling normalizes to 6mer at read time; the registry file is never rewritten).

auroc.description: Null when nothing was scorable or only one label class is present (no fabricated AUROC).

asymmetry.description: |auroc_forward - auroc_rc|; null when either side is missing.

pass.description: True iff nonsense_median < synonymous_median (alt-minus-ref convention); null when either median is missing.
